Problem Statement:
Ravi is doing his schooling and he has got a homework problem to solve. The objective of the problem is to find whether any 3 numbers in given list of numbers can satisfy the formation:a^2+b^2=c^2. Your task is to help ravi in determining whether a triplet (a,b,c) exists or not. If a triplet is possible print yes else no. O(n^2) is required
input_spec: First line of test case contains a number t denoting number of testcases. First line of each test case contains a number n,next line contains n space seperated integers.
